name: Pyrewood Village
summary: Isolated Pyrewood Village lies beneath Shadowfang Keep in southern Silverpine Forest. Once part of Gilneas, the settlement was stranded outside the Greymane Wall, and Arugal's curse now haunts its living residents.

sections.title: A Town Severed
sections.body: Pyrewood was once a prosperous Gilnean settlement. After the Second War, King Genn Greymane sealed Gilneas behind the massive Greymane Wall, leaving Pyrewood on the wrong side. Cut off from their homeland, the townsfolk were entirely defenseless as the Scourge crossed Lordaeron during the Third War. They survived the first wave of undead, but their nightmare began when the mage Arugal took refuge in the fortress above.

sections.title: The Moonrage Curse
sections.body: Archmage Arugal unleashed otherworldly beasts from Shadowfang Keep and cursed Pyrewood's living residents. By day, they look like ordinary human villagers and keep their normal faculties as they tend the town hall, blacksmith, and chapel. The village merchants even trade with visiting Alliance travelers. When the sun sets, every resident becomes a savage, bloodthirsty worgen of the Moonrage pack. Anyone left within the village walls is attacked.

faq.q: Why does Pyrewood Village attack me at night?
faq.answer: Archmage Arugal of Shadowfang Keep cursed Pyrewood's villagers. By day, they keep their human forms and normal faculties, but each night they become ravenous Moonrage worgen and attack outsiders on sight.

faq.q: Why is Pyrewood outside the Greymane Wall?
faq.answer: King Genn Greymane ordered the Greymane Wall built to seal Gilneas away from the outside world after the Second War. Pyrewood ended up on the wrong side, leaving its residents to fend for themselves.

faq.q: Can Alliance players visit Pyrewood safely?
faq.answer: Yes, Alliance travelers can visit and trade with the village merchants during daylight. After dark, the entire village transforms into hostile worgen, whatever your faction.

faq.q: How does the Horde view Pyrewood?
faq.answer: The Forsaken see Pyrewood as an intolerable threat on their southern border. Under agents such as Deathstalker Faerleia, the Horde seeks to assassinate the village's council and sever Pyrewood's ties to Arugal.

angles.text: Pyrewood is a tragic remnant of living humanity in Lordaeron. Its people trade with travelers by day, then succumb to a horrific curse each night.
The Forsaken see Pyrewood as a lingering pocket of hostile humans and monstrous worgen serving Archmage Arugal on the border of their lands.
